text: The inspected files browser_accountHubAddressBookLocalForm.js, browser_accountHubAddressBook.js and browser_accountHubAb.js use the browser_ harness prefix followed by a component suffix. Named tasks use test_captureState, test_localAddressBookForwardEventAndCreation and test_localAddressBookCreation: test_ plus a concrete action. This scopes a naming family for these Account Hub browser tests; other components use different task casing. Preserve existing harness names and distinguish state capture, view-level Forward handling and integration creation. title: Account Hub browser test names keep the harness prefix separate from the tested action
